items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 20:1
items.html: This is for two reasons. The first, because all these levels are discerned as reflected light, as explained above in Item 85. And the second, because everything that descends below the place of the coupling is reflected light and not direct light. (Chapter 4, Inner Light, Item 2)
